prompt:
Purpose: Natural photorealistic photo

Image Type: Everyday photo for the SNS Prompt and Variation series.

Scene: September 8, 05:52, Yokohama. Early morning in dim light at a small dresser at home. Outside is humid and overcast, with intermittent rain. A faint cool light from the window and a modest warm-colored household lamp illuminate the room.

Person: One fictional adult Japanese woman. 23 years old, 157 cm tall, pastry chef. Small heart-shaped face, soft and plump upper cheeks, short rounded chin, slightly wide-set large round dark brown eyes, short gently sloping eyebrows, small rounded nose tip, distinct cupid's bow, neutral ivory skin. Dark cocoa brown bob haircut reaching just below the jaw, with light bangs and slightly inward-curling ends. Healthy, petite adult build with soft upper arms, a moderately sized waist, and a naturally full chest proportionate to her body.

Outfit and Action: An opaque dusty pink fine-ribbed camisole that fits the body naturally, paired with ivory cotton loungewear shorts. Shoulders, arms, and legs above the knees are naturally visible, with the opaque fabric covering the standard areas. Sitting sideways on a chair, gently applying a small makeup puff to one cheek with one hand, while placing the other hand on her lap. Gazing into the mirror of the dresser with a focused expression showing remaining drowsiness. The bob is worn down, without her work hairpins.

Composition: A natural snapshot from a side-front angle at a regular indoor distance. Includes the head, upper body, shorts, legs down to just below the knees, and enough of the dresser and room to clarify the action. The mirror is placed at the edge of the frame or diagonally, ensuring it does not reflect a second face. The contact between puff, hand, and cheek must look physically natural.

Photographic Description: Captured using a standard smartphone rear camera at 1x magnification, 26-28mm equivalent, using standard camera mode instead of portrait mode. A single natural focal plane, with details gradually diminishing according to distance. The face, neck, arms, and room share the same ambient light and exposure, leaving natural darkness on the far cheek and around the eyes. Distant skin shows subtle variations across broad ranges of color, while close skin shows fine irregularities limited to realistic resolution ranges. Modest HDR and sharpness, slight automated white balance shifts, dark area noise, light compression, and only very faint blur on moving fingers or hair. No face-only glow, bleaching, smoothing, relighting, or separate sharpening. Differentiate textures of skin, cloth, hair, and furniture. All illumination must be explainable by existing windows and household lights.

Output and Constraints: One photorealistic vertical 3:4 image. Desired size is 1086x1448 pixels. No grids. Exactly one adult female. Natural human anatomy with correctly attached hands and limbs. No text, logos, or watermarks. Do not crop into close-ups of body parts alone, maintaining a casual, naturally charming, adult-like appearance.
